error_model_scope: Configured Gaussian range error, N(0, 0.03 m), plus an NLOS bias applied to a fraction of links. Parameterised to the +/-10 cm class accuracy the YERKON presentation states for the DWM3000 module. No calibrated DWM3000 measurements were available to this project, so this is a design target expressed as a distribution, not a measured error model.
error_model_caveats: NLOS probability 10% and bias 0.30 m are this project's assumptions, not measurements.
